ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_advantage_ratio_exp_neg
ir.intuition: leverages an exponential decay of the negative ratio between log-prob difference and advantage gap, promoting pairs where the model confidently favors winning samples proportional to their advantage; shifts paradigm from margin/logsigmoid to ratio-scaled exp loss
ir.pseudocode:
ratio = (lpw - lpl) / (adv_gap + epsilon)
loss = exp(-clamp(ratio, -10, 10))
weighted_loss = weight * loss
return mean(weighted_loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    eps = 1e-6
    ratio = ops.div(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), ops.add(ops.abs(adv_gap), eps))
    ratio_clamped = ops.clamp(ratio, -10.0, 10.0)
    loss = ops.exp(ops.neg(ratio_clamped))
    loss_weighted = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss_weighted)
